question: In which of the following states or union territories is the Hemis Monastery located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ladakh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In** Hemis, Ladakh, India,** there is a** Drukpa Lineage Himalayan Buddhist monastery** called **Hemis Monastery.**
 
• It was restored in** 1672 by the Ladakhi king Sengge Namgyal.**
 
• It is situated **45 km from Leh.**
 
• The** endangered snow leopard** is found in the vicinity of the **Hemis National Park.**
 
• **Early June **sees the annual** Hemis celebration honouring Padmasambhava.**
 
• **Monks **display the triumph of **good over evil** by dressing in colourful, flowing robes and wearing **character-appropriate attire.**
